title: Judge upholds £1m will favouring niece and nephew over 18 relatives claiming Cyprus flat inheritance
summary_full: A high court judge ruled that an English will from 2015 is valid, leaving the estate to named beneficiaries. The decision rejected a later 2019 Cypriot will, which aimed to distribute property among 18 relatives. The judge determined that the Cypriot document did not cancel the earlier English will due to its specific wording.
